demand_pool.ranking: for each stratum d, ascending SHA-256(seed | 'demand' | d | demand_id); select first eligible definition containing d
demand_pool.terminology_audit: The canonical catalogue does not expose a primary_domain field. This packet predeclares strata 1 through 18 over north_star_domains; it does not invent a new catalogue classification.

pairing: ranked selected subjects in order; positions 1-2 -> domain 1, 3-4 -> domain 2, …, 35-36 -> domain 18
redistribution_if_short: If fewer than two instances can be formed for a stratum, fill in ascending domain number using an unfilled catalogue-covered stratum with available eligible subjects; record the shortage. If total <24, stop without freezing a runnable holdout.

subject_pool.eligibility: unique governed ACNC identity binding; excluded from all supplied current Gate-3 semantic exposure ledgers
